caption: The button on a toy light-sabre is pressed, and the blade lights up from the handle outward to the tip.

sa.check: A toy light-sabre with a handle and a blade.
The button on the handle is pressed.
The glow runs from the handle outward to the tip.
The blade is dark before the press.
The order is dark, press, lit from the handle to the tip.

pc.expect: The blade begins to light at the press, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the blade stays dark to the end of the clip; or the blade is lit before the press; or the blade lights with nothing touching the handle; or only the handle lights.

pc.expect: The glow starts at the handle end and travels to the tip, then the whole blade stays lit; it does not start at the tip or run back.
pc.fail: The glow starts at the tip and runs toward the handle; or runs to the tip and then retreats; or lights in patches out of order; or the blade goes dark again by itself.

pc.expect: The lit blade throws its colour onto the hand, the handle and nearby surfaces.
pc.fail: The blade glows while the hand and surroundings stay as dark as before; or the surroundings glow while the blade is dark; or the glow on the surroundings is a different colour from the blade.

pc.expect: The blade is a rigid tube that stays straight and fixed to the handle.
pc.fail: The blade bends or droops; or stretches longer as it lights; or wobbles like rubber; or detaches from the handle.

pc.expect: One sabre with one blade; it keeps its shape; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second blade appears; or the blade vanishes; or the hand passes through the handle; or the sabre changes shape.

pc.expect: The handle's colour and the background stay the same; the blade keeps one colour once lit.
pc.fail: The handle changes colour; or the blade changes colour after lighting; or the background rearranges.
